name: @acc/decho-basemap
description: A MapLibre vector basemap served entirely from Foundry — PMTiles, glyphs and sprites from datasets or media sets, with no external network calls.
//files: src is shipped deliberately: the .js.map and .d.ts.map files reference ../src/*, so without it every stack trace and go-to-definition in a consumer dead-ends. It also makes the tarball a complete, relocatable copy of the package.
//scripts: build:deps is a real prerequisite, not ceremony: tsconfig.build.json resolves @acc/decho-foundry-bytes to its BUILT declarations, because source would drag those files into this program and tsc would refuse to emit them from outside rootDir.
//peerDependencies: Deliberately wide. 0.1.0 pinned the exact @osdk versions its home repo happened to have (>=2.59.0 etc), which broke installation into an app on ^2.56.0 with an ERESOLVE conflict — for a package that uses one TYPE from @osdk/client and two stable call sites in the foundry.* packages. Widen rather than force consumers onto --legacy-peer-deps. (This note lives outside the peerDependencies object: a '//' key inside it would be read as a package literally named '//'.)
